app.title: Thousands of Lives
app.tagline: One life in a random country and age — from pharaohs to samurai and Incas. Learn, survive, believe, shape your fate and decide whether your family line goes on.
beta.notice: This is a beta. Historical texts were prepared with the help of AI and have not yet been checked by a historian. The game now has 13 countries of the world before the Age of Discovery.

setup.mode.full.desc: More events and decisions, about 20 minutes

setup.mortality.historical.desc: As in the sources: almost a third of children died before age one

about.title: About the data and sources
about.body1: Thousands of Lives simulates a single human life in the past. We try to make events, occupations, laws and risks fit the era, but the game is a simplification.
about.body2: Mortality follows the Coale–Demeny model life tables ("West", levels 3–5) that historians use for pre-industrial societies. Life expectancy at birth is 24–30 years, mostly because of high child mortality. This is a reconstruction, not exact data.
about.body3: Every historian's note is marked "confirmed by sources", "reconstruction" or "disputed".
about.beta: The beta texts were prepared with the help of AI and have not yet been checked by a historian. If you spot a mistake, let us know.
about.beta_portal: The beta texts were prepared with the help of AI and have not yet been checked by a historian. If you spot a mistake, please tell us in the comments on the game's page.
about.source.1: Coale A., Demeny P. Regional Model Life Tables and Stable Populations. 2nd ed. 1983.
about.source.2: Bagnall R., Frier B. The Demography of Roman Egypt. Cambridge, 1994.
about.source.3: Scheidel W. (ed.) The Cambridge Companion to the Roman Economy. 2012.
about.source.4: Thucydides. History of the Peloponnesian War (on the war and the plague of Athens).
about.source.5: Polybius, Livy, Plutarch, Suetonius on events of Roman history.
about.privacy: Saves are stored only in your browser. Yandex Metrica is used for visit statistics.
about.privacy_portal: Your saves are kept in your browser and, if you are signed in to CrazyGames, in your account. The game collects no statistics of its own.

menu.how.1.title: Birth is a lottery
menu.how.1.text: Three reels decide where, when and who you are born: a samurai's son in Kyoto, a weaver's daughter in Florence or a slave in Baghdad. Faith, station and family are drawn by lot too.
menu.how.2.title: Time flows by itself
menu.how.2.text: A year lasts a few seconds, early childhood even less; in Settings you can stretch it to a minute. Life flows as a feed: childhood, work, weddings, news from the world. You can speed it up or pause it.
menu.how.3.title: Choices shape fate
menu.how.3.text: Learning, trade, marriage, health, risk — and turning points: pirates, buried treasure, a false accusation. Consequences catch up years later.
menu.how.4.title: The family goes on
menu.how.4.text: After death comes the life summary and a Life pattern of 16 archetypes. Continue as your child or be born again.
menu.no_lives: None yet. A first life takes about 15 minutes.

religion.roman_gods.desc: Jupiter, Juno, Mars and the household lares: sacrifices, omens, festivals by the calendar.
religion.egyptian_gods.desc: Ra, Osiris, Isis, Ptah: temples, priests, belief in the judgement of the dead.
religion.mesopotamian_gods.desc: Marduk, Ishtar, Shamash: ziggurats, liver divination, omens.
religion.slavic_pagan.desc: Perun, Veles, Mokosh, house spirits and wood spirits: offerings, amulets, sanctuaries.
religion.judaism.desc: One God, the Torah, the Sabbath, the synagogue and the community.
religion.christian.desc: Faith in Christ: prayer, fasting, the community and its bishop.
religion.catholic.desc: The Latin Church: the Mass, the Pope, monasteries, pilgrimages to relics.
religion.orthodox.desc: The Eastern Church: liturgy, icons, fasts, monasteries.
religion.tewahedo.desc: The Church of Ethiopia: strict fasts, a tabot ark in every church, monasteries on cliffs.
religion.islam.desc: God and His Prophet: five daily prayers, the Ramadan fast, alms, the hajj to Mecca.
religion.zoroastrian.desc: Ahura Mazda, the sacred fire, the struggle of good and evil.
religion.hindu.desc: Shiva, Vishnu, the Goddess: temples, rites, castes, pilgrimages to holy rivers.
religion.buddhist.desc: The teaching of the Buddha: monasteries, meditation, rebirth and the path to liberation.
religion.jain.desc: Non-violence to all living things, strict fasts, ascetics.
religion.chinese_folk.desc: Confucian duty, veneration of ancestors, Daoist spirits and rites.
religion.shinto.desc: Kami — spirits of mountains, rivers and ancestors; shrines, purification, festivals.
religion.maya_gods.desc: Itzamna, Chaak, Kukulkan: the calendar, bloodletting, the ball game.
religion.aztec_gods.desc: Huitzilopochtli, Tlaloc, Quetzalcoatl: the sun feeds on sacrifice.
religion.andean.desc: Inti the Sun, Pachamama the Earth, huacas, ancestor mummies.
religion.african_traditional.desc: Spirits of ancestors and nature, healers and diviners, offerings and masks.

diary.home_patched: The burned house was never properly rebuilt — just patched up somehow, and lived in.
diary.home_down: You had to sell your home and move somewhere humbler — now it is {home}.

life.focus_now: Now: {focus}. You can change it any time; it applies from the next year.
life.focus_explain: The focus is what your hero gives this year to: work, study, family, faith or rest. It shapes skills, money, ties and health, and which events are more likely to happen.

hint.focus: Now you decide what each year is about. Pick a focus — it shapes skills, money and events.

early.fact: It happened to many: {region} in those years only {n} children in a hundred lived to fifteen.
settings.year.auto.desc: About {n} seconds a year, early childhood faster
sound.title: Music
sound.ios_hint: Can't hear the music? Check your phone's silent switch and volume.
settings.music.desc: A calm melody of your country and era
ach.age_60.title: Grey Hair
ach.age_60.hint: Good food, exercise and a physician add 6–8 years to an adult's life.
ach.age_70.title: Elder
ach.age_70.hint: Look after your health: Hero tab → Health and daily life.
ach.age_80.title: Fourscore
ach.age_80.hint: Few managed it: it takes plenty, peace and luck.
ach.long_medieval.title: A Long Age
ach.long_medieval.desc: Live to 85 in the Middle Ages (any country except the Ancient world).
ach.long_medieval.hint: Less risk, more care for your health — and patience.
ach.ancient_80.title: Ancient Elder
ach.ancient_80.desc: Live to 80 in the Ancient world: Rome, Hellas, Egypt, Babylon.
ach.ancient_80.hint: In the Ancient world clean water, the baths and a physician matter most.
ach.defy_era.title: Defying the Age
ach.defy_era.desc: Live 25 years longer than the average adult of your time.
ach.defy_era.hint: The average adult lifespan is shown in the life summary, next to the comparison with the age.
ach.century.title: A Hundred Years
ach.plague_survivor.title: Survived the Plague
ach.plague_survivor.desc: Fall ill during an epidemic — and survive.
ach.plague_survivor.hint: During a plague you can nurse the sick — dangerous, but that's how legends are born.
ach.heir.title: Heir
ach.heir.desc: Carry on the family: live the life of an heir.
ach.heir.hint: After your hero dies, choose an heir.
ach.gen_5.title: Five Generations
ach.gen_5.desc: Five lives of one family in a row.
ach.gen_5.hint: For the line to go on you need children — and they must reach adulthood.
ach.gen_10.title: Ten Generations
ach.gen_10.desc: Ten lives of one family in a row.
ach.gen_10.hint: A whole dynasty: protect your children and choose heirs wisely.
ach.via_grandchild.title: Through a Grandchild
ach.via_grandchild.desc: Carry on the family through a grandchild or great-grandchild when no children are left.
ach.via_grandchild.hint: If your children have died, a grandchild can be the heir.
ach.great_grandchild.title: A Great-Grandchild
ach.great_grandchild.desc: Live to see a great-grandchild born.
ach.great_grandchild.hint: It takes a long life and early marriages in the family.
ach.big_family.title: A Big Family
ach.big_family.hint: The "Family" focus of the year brings more children.
ach.family_century.title: A Century-Long Line
ach.family_century.desc: One family's chronicle spans 100 years from the first birth to the last death.
ach.family_century.hint: Keep the family going through heirs.
ach.family_two_centuries.title: Two Centuries
ach.family_two_centuries.hint: Long lives and late heirs make the chronicle longer.
ach.to_be_continued.title: To Be Continued
ach.to_be_continued.desc: The family reached the end of its country's era.
ach.to_be_continued.hint: Keep the family going for generations until the country's chronicle ends.
ach.rags_to_riches.title: Rags to Riches
ach.rags_to_riches.desc: Be born a slave or peasant and die a landowner or noble.
ach.rags_to_riches.hint: Trade, service, a good marriage — and a little risk.
ach.freedom.title: Freedom
ach.freedom.desc: Be born a slave and win your freedom.
ach.freedom.hint: Save for your ransom, serve faithfully — or run.
ach.born_in_chains.title: Born in Chains
ach.born_in_chains.desc: Be born a slave and die free, wealthy and over 60.
ach.born_in_chains.hint: First freedom, then a trade of your own and a long life.
ach.fall.title: The Fall
ach.fall.desc: Be born a noble and die in debt.
ach.fall.hint: Feasts, dice and bad deals will do the job.
ach.master.title: Master of the Craft
ach.master.desc: Reach the top of your trade or service: your own workshop, ship, rank or office.
ach.master.hint: Stick to one trade for years — that's when promotion comes.
ach.scholar.title: Bookworm
ach.scholar.hint: Study as a child and the "Learning" focus as an adult.
ach.pilgrim.title: Pilgrim
ach.pilgrim.desc: Make a pilgrimage: the hajj, Jerusalem, Ise, Kashi, a shrine of your faith.
ach.pilgrim.hint: When the road to a holy place calls — go.
ach.defiant.title: Defiance
ach.defiant.desc: Refuse the marriage your parents chose — and still have a family.
ach.defiant.hint: In a betrothal event you can refuse to obey.
ach.golden_wedding.title: Golden Wedding
ach.golden_wedding.hint: An early marriage and a long life — for both.
ach.unbroken.title: Unbroken
ach.unbroken.desc: Be widowed, marry again and live to 60.
ach.unbroken.hint: After a loss, life goes on.
ach.pillar.title: Pillar of the Family
ach.pillar.desc: Live to see all your grown children married (at least two).
ach.pillar.hint: A long life and a large family.
ach.traveler.title: Traveler
ach.traveler.desc: Live in three different places in one life.
ach.witness.title: Witness to History
ach.witness.desc: Live through 5 historical events in one life.
ach.witness.hint: The longer the life, the more history outside your window.
ach.worlds_5.title: Five Worlds
ach.worlds_5.desc: Live lives in five different countries.
ach.worlds_5.hint: Start a new life — the lottery will cast you into another country.
ach.worlds_13.title: All Thirteen
ach.worlds_13.desc: Live lives in all thirteen countries.
ach.worlds_13.hint: Check the country collection to see which are still missing.
ach.both_fates.title: Both Fates
ach.both_fates.desc: Live a man's life and a woman's life in the same country.
ach.both_fates.hint: You can choose the sex in the life setup.
ach.faithful_friend.title: A Faithful Friend
ach.faithful_friend.desc: A dog lived with the family for 15 years.
ach.faithful_friend.hint: Take in a puppy — and feed it even in a hungry year.
ach.old_tortoise.title: Great-Grandfather's Tortoise
ach.old_tortoise.desc: A pet stays in the family for 40 years and passes to the heir.
ach.old_tortoise.hint: Tortoises and parrots outlive their owners.
ach.iron_health.title: Iron Health
ach.iron_health.desc: Live to 70 without ever falling seriously ill (historical mortality only).
ach.iron_health.hint: Look after yourself and don't gamble with your health.
ach.no_mistakes.title: No Room for Error
ach.no_mistakes.desc: Live to 60 in the first life of a family, unprotected, under historical mortality.
ach.no_mistakes.hint: Turn on historical mortality in the settings.
ach.centurion.title: Centurion
ach.centurion.hint: Serve in the legion — and years of loyalty.
ach.free_gladiator.title: Free Gladiator
ach.free_gladiator.desc: Rome: be a gladiator and live to 40.
ach.pharaoh_scribe.title: Scribe
ach.pharaoh_scribe.desc: Egypt and Babylon: become a scribe.
ach.pharaoh_scribe.hint: Study in childhood opens the way to tablets and papyri.
ach.embalmer.title: Embalmer
ach.embalmer.hint: A trade for those unafraid of death.
ach.hegumen.title: Abbot
ach.hegumen.desc: Byzantium: become the abbot of a monastery.
ach.hegumen.hint: First the tonsure, then years in the cloister.
ach.charioteer.title: Charioteer
ach.charioteer.desc: Byzantium: become a charioteer of the Hippodrome.
ach.charioteer.hint: Strength and risk — the darlings of Constantinople.
ach.jinshi.title: Examination Scholar
ach.porcelain.title: Porcelain Master
ach.porcelain.hint: A craft the whole world knows.
ach.debtera.title: Debtera
ach.debtera.desc: Ethiopia: become a debtera — church singer and scholar.
ach.rock_church.title: Rock-Church Carver
ach.rock_church.desc: Ethiopia: carve churches out of rock.
ach.rock_church.hint: Craft and a lifetime of patience.
ach.knight.title: Knight
ach.knight.hint: War, service to a lord and a little luck.
ach.cathedral.title: Cathedral Builder
ach.mahout.title: Mahout
ach.mahout.hint: An elephant remembers its mahout all its life.
ach.court_poet.title: Court Poet
ach.hajji.title: Hajji
ach.hajji.desc: The Islamic world: make the hajj.
ach.hajji.hint: When you've saved for the road — set off for Mecca.
ach.astronomer.title: Astronomer
ach.astronomer.desc: The Islamic world: become an astronomer.
ach.astronomer.hint: Study and literacy open the doors of observatories.
ach.samurai.title: Samurai
ach.samurai.hint: The way of the warrior begins with birth in the right family — or a great deed.
ach.tea_master.title: Tea Master
ach.tea_master.desc: Japan: become a master of the tea ceremony.
ach.ballplayer.title: Ballplayer
ach.ballplayer.desc: Maya: become a player of the sacred ballgame.
ach.ballplayer.hint: Strength and agility — and the favor of the gods.
ach.jade_carver.title: Jade Carver
ach.jade_carver.hint: Jade is worth more than gold.
ach.druzhinnik.title: Druzhinnik
ach.druzhinnik.desc: Rus: serve in a prince's retinue.
ach.druzhinnik.hint: Strength and loyalty to the prince.
ach.bell_caster.title: Bell Caster
ach.griot.title: Griot
ach.griot.desc: Mali: become a griot — keeper of memory.
ach.griot.hint: Words and the memory of families.
ach.gold_of_mali.title: Gold of Mali
ach.gold_of_mali.hint: Hard work — and a chance to get rich.
ach.eagle_warrior.title: Eagle Warrior
ach.eagle_warrior.hint: Only for those who distinguished themselves in battle.
ach.chasqui.title: Chasqui
ach.title: Awards
ach.dream_first.title: Visitor from the Future
ach.dream_first.desc: Make a breakthrough in a dream of the future.
ach.dream_first.hint: Dreams come from your second life, at ages 15–40. Remember your school days.
ach.dream_5.title: A Scholar for All Ages
ach.dream_5.hint: Every country brings a new dream and new numbers.
ach.dream_no_hint.title: No Cheat Sheet
ach.dream_no_hint.desc: A breakthrough in a dream with a debate of sages — without a hint.
ach.dream_no_hint.hint: Don't open the textbook while the sages argue.
ach.dream_known.title: Reinventing the Wheel
ach.dream_known.desc: Solve a dream correctly in a country that already knew the answer.
ach.dream_known.hint: Sometimes you are not the first — solving it still feels good.
ach.secret_dream_boom.title: Should Have Studied
ach.secret_dream_boom.desc: Die because a dream of the future went wrong.
ach.secret_dream_boom.hint: Guess at random in a dream and you will find out.
school.train: Tap a dream you have had to replay it with new numbers, with no effect on any life.
school.title: School curriculum
school.lead: Dreams of the future: the ones solved correctly are filled in. Dreams you haven't had yet show as “???”.
summary.cmp_adult_more: You lived {n} {p=n:year|years} — {d} {p=d:year|years} longer than the average adult of your time.
summary.cmp_adult_less: You lived {n} {p=n:year|years} — {d} {p=d:year|years} less than the average adult of your time.
lifestyle.bonus: Varied food, walks, a physician and the baths add an adult here about {n} {p=n:year|years} of life on average.
diary.era_end: The chronicle of the era "{era}" is coming to an end. Your family has gone through {n} {p=n:generation|generations} — to be continued.
era_end.title: The chronicle of this era has ended
era_end.text: Your family has gone through {n} {p=n:generation|generations}. The heir would live most of their life after the end of the chronicle "{era}". To be continued: when the next era arrives in the game, you'll be able to carry this family on. It is saved in the memorial.
era_end.off_hint: From here on — no historical events, news or primers: only the life of the family.
summary.off_chronicle: This life was lived outside the chronicle — after the end of the country's era, since {year}.
diary.emigrated_trade: You moved: your home is now {place} ({country}). Trading in a foreign land means starting over.
diary.emigrated_refugee: You came to {place} ({country}) as refugees. Everything you had stayed behind.
diary.emigrated_captive: You were sold into bondage: {place} ({country}). Home now exists only in dreams.
diary.emigrated_marriage: You moved to your spouse in {place} ({country}).
diary.emigrated_faith: You stayed to live by the holy places: {place} ({country}).
diary.emigrated_invited: You were invited to work abroad: {place} ({country}).
diary.returned_home: You came home to {place} after {n} {p=n:year|years} abroad.
diary.no_homeland: There's nowhere to return to: what was your country ({country}) is no more.
diary.away_homeland: {who} went back home, to the relatives.
abroad.status: You've been abroad for {n} {p=n:year|years}: living far from home ({homeland}) since {year}.
abroad.naturalized: You come from "{homeland}", but you belong here now: you've lived here {n} {p=n:year|years}.
abroad.planned: You'll decide about going home next year.
ach.stranger_20.title: A Stranger Among Others
ach.stranger_20.hint: Events offer a move: trade, service, an invitation.
ach.naturalized.title: One of Them
ach.naturalized.desc: Settle in abroad so well that you become a resident of the new country.
ach.naturalized.hint: Learn the language, start a local family and don't rush back.
ach.half_world.title: Halfway Across the World
ach.half_world.desc: Move to a distant country — halfway across the world.
ach.half_world.hint: Distant roads aren't always open: for example, from Rus to the Islamic world.
ach.prodigal.title: The Prodigal
ach.prodigal.hint: Leave, live long — and still come back.
ach.three_lands.title: A Family of Three Lands
ach.three_lands.desc: The family has lived in three different countries.
ach.three_lands.hint: Moves and heirs — and your family will see half the world.
country.title: Where will you be born next?
country.lead: Thank you for the feedback! While the trial lasts, you choose the country of birth — chance decides the year, region and station. You can change it in “Customize life” under the reels.
country.random.desc: As usual: the lottery picks the country
country.picked: Country chosen by you: {era}. Chance decides the rest.
country.prompt.title: Country of your next life
country.prompt.random: Chance picks it for now. Thanks for the feedback — during the trial you can choose it yourself.
country.prompt.chosen: You chose: {era}. Chance decides the year, region and station.
setup.country.locked: During the trial you can choose it yourself — for a short review of the game.
feedback.prompt.reward.title: Choose where to be born
feedback.prompt.reward.text: This is a beta, and the game changes with players’ feedback. Tell us in a couple of sentences what you liked and what to fix — and while the trial lasts, you will choose the country of your next lives.
spin.fate: Fate is sealed — life will show the rest.
spin.ad.fail: No ad available right now — try again a bit later.
menu.tagline: One life in a random country and age — from pharaohs to samurai. Will your bloodline go on?
challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.start: Live your next life past {n} — and as a reward you choose your fate: be born into a noble family or in a country of your choice.
challenge.retry: You didn’t live past {n} this time. The challenge waits in your next life: live it past {n} and you choose your fate.
challenge.ready.title: A reward awaits
challenge.ready: Challenge complete! At the reels, choose the fate of your next life: a noble family or a country of your choice.
challenge.note: Challenge: live this life past {n} — the reward: you choose the fate of the next one.
challenge.toast: Challenge complete! In your next life you choose your fate.
fate.title: Challenge reward — choose your fate
fate.country.lead: Challenge reward: you choose the country; chance decides the year, region and station. It works for one life.
install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.text: Add Thousands of Lives to your phone’s home screen — your next life is one tap away.
install.ios: In Safari tap “Share” (the square with an arrow at the bottom), then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.reward: 🎁 Reward: your next life begins in the royal family.
install.reward.ios: 🎁 Reward: open the game from its home-screen icon and your next life begins in the royal family.
royal.toast: Home-screen reward: your next life begins in the royal family!
royal.note: Home-screen reward: this life begins in the royal family. The rest is up to chance.
